title: We’re Marching to Zion
alsoKnownAs: Come, We That Love the Lord
description: We’re Marching to Zion in Tonic Solfa to MARCHING TO ZION: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the six verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts’s words were published in 1707. Robert Lowry added the refrain and wrote the tune in 1867.
underlay: Come, we that love the Lord, And let our joys be known__; Join in a song with sweet ac-cord, Join in a song with sweet ac-cord, And thus sur-round the throne, And thus sur-round the throne. We’re march-ing to Zi-on, Beau-ti-ful, beau-ti-ful Zi-on; We’re march-ing up-ward to Zi-on, The beau-ti-ful cit-y of_ God.

lines: Come, we that love the Lord,
And let our joys be known;
Join in a song with sweet accord,
But children of the heav’nly King
The men of grace have found
From faith and hope may grow.
Before we reach the heav’nly fields,
